`final class UIStoreHook`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.hook.store` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIStoreHook.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/hook/store/UIStoreHook.java)

Creates, caches, saves and destroys the stores that the UIs use.

## Description

[`UI.useStore`](/reference/ui/ui/#UI-method-useStore) goes through it; you call it yourself only to reach a shared store outside a UI.

- [Stores and properties](/use/learn/state/stores-and-properties/)

## Method details

<a id="UIStoreHook-method-useStore"></a>

### useStore

`<T extends UIStore> T useStore(Class<T> clazz, Supplier<T> factory)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns the shared store of this class when it exists; otherwise creates one with the factory, runs `init()` and, for a `PERMANENT` store, restores its file.
A `GLOBAL` or `PERMANENT` store is kept for the next calls; a `LOCAL` store is not.

<a id="UIStoreHook-method-destroyStore"></a>

### destroyStore

`void destroyStore(UIStore store)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Forgets a shared store and runs its `destroy()`.

### saveStore

`void saveStore(UIStore store)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

<a id="UIStoreHook-method-saveAll"></a>

### saveAll

`void saveAll()` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

<a id="UIStoreHook-method-getData"></a>

### getData

`UIStoreData getData(Class<? extends UIStore> clazz)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: The store … has no @UIStoreData annotation, add it to the class

The `@UIStoreData` annotation of a store class.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when the class has none.
